tip: Домой (domoy = homeward) already means 'to home', so it needs no preposition and no case change.
Motion onto a surface takes на plus accusative: на стол (na stol = onto the table). Resting on it would be на столе (na stole).
Мне жаль (mne zhal = I'm sorry) uses a dative person plus жаль, with no verb for 'to be'.
The verb поможет (pomozhet = will help) takes a dative object, so друг (drug) becomes другу (drugu = to a friend).
Wishing someone something uses genitive: Удачи (udachi = good luck), a shortened form of 'I wish you luck'.
Через (cherez = in) plus accusative sets a time from now: Через час (cherez chas = in an hour).
The verb мечтает (mechtaet = dreams) takes о plus prepositional: о красивом доме (o krasivom dome = about a beautiful house).
По (po = along) plus dative traces movement over a surface: по набережной (po naberezhnoy = along the embankment).
After a quantity word the counted noun goes genitive plural: килограмм яблок (kilogramm yablok = a kilo of apples).
Some masculine nouns take a stressed -у in the location case: саду (sadu = in the garden), from сад (sad), not саде (sade).
С (s = with) plus instrumental gives manner here: с удовольствием (s udovolstviem = with pleasure, gladly).
The verb играет (igraet = plays) takes в plus accusative for games: в шахматы (v shakhmaty = chess).
встречались (vstrechalis = met) ends in a reflexive -сь (-s), which with a plural subject reads as reciprocal: they met each other.
